args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

The docstring and tests/test_money.py expect ROUND_HALF_EVEN, but the
implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP. E.g. Decimal("2.665") was rounded to
2.67 instead of 2.66. Aligns implementation with FIN-212 requirement.

args.body:
## Problem
`round_money` in `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but the docstring, `tests/test_money.py`, and FIN-212 all require banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This broke the nightly build: `Decimal("2.665")` rounded to `2.67` instead of `2.66`.

## Fix
Switch the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `src/money.py`.

## Testing
CI run `ci-0001` (sha `08d3cd5986`): **passed** ✅
